narrative.objectives: The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect.  Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you so much, adventurer!! You have saved the Stonewrought Dam! Without your help, the Dark Iron terrorists would have surely seen to this mighty landmark's demise. You have made the Kingdom and the Alliance proud, brave Champion.

The Dam is once again safe. . . for the time being at least. . . .

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 18 to 20, 7,690 XP in all.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.objectiveText: Investigate the area near the eastern ramp of the Dam and bring Chief Engineer Hinderweir a clue that might reveal what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.objectiveText: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.objectiveText: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert in Dun Modr.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.objectiveText: Ashlan Stonesmirk wants you to return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and inform him of the new discovery.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.objectiveText: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.objectiveText: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.objectiveText: The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect.
